Both skipped.

sources.informs: NW water front: boarded tall openings, small arched upper windows, string course
SE side: two storeys of round-arched windows between pilasters
NE gable: stepped corbel frieze, three bays, big window over loading door
SW gable end: small windows under the apex, doors, pilaster strips
